text:
nora: UX quick check: in the trace panel, should the correlation ID be inline in the header or collapsed behind an affordance? Users ask for instant copy when filing bugs.

eli: inline makes triage faster. put a small copy icon next to the ID; only visible on hover/focus.

sam: accessibility catch: if icon is hidden visually, make sure it's still focusable via keyboard when the frame is focused. aria-label like 'Copy correlation ID 0xabc' is needed.

nora: proposed microcopy: tooltip 'Copy correlation ID (expires in 7 days)'. keeps user expectations clear.

aria-bot: a11y tip: use aria-live='polite' for the copied confirmation; don't rely solely on color.

eli: implementation note: use tabindex='-1' by default on the icon and switch to '0' when frame gets focus to avoid extra tab stops. also add a short animation when copied.

sam: analytics: track 'correlation_copy_inline' vs 'header_copy' to measure adoption.

nora: ok i'll mock the hover state and push copy changes. If no objections i'll ship the microcopy and aria hints in the next component PR. :+1:
